count_definitions.paper_group: Corpus DOI/document grouping. It is not a count of independently identity-verified primary papers; duplicate/mismatched payloads remain in the corpus metadata.
count_definitions.synthesis_route_variant: Distinct reviewed canonical route or condition-variant used for publication, not necessarily a complete executable recipe, unique physical batch or independent experiment.
count_definitions.contextual_control: Source-scoped controls or diagnostic variants, counted separately from synthesis routes, supporting procedures and observations; not automatically independent physical experiments.
count_definitions.procedure: Precursor preparation, isolation, size-selection, ligand exchange, post-treatment, acquisition or assay records. Not additional material syntheses.
count_definitions.recipe_family: Grouping identifiers used to connect related source protocols and procedures. They are not unique physical recipes or independent runs.
count_definitions.material_system: Direct synthesis targets retain product architecture and unresolved composition; component-only hubs link the whole-system route without claiming an isolated component synthesis.
count_definitions.benchmark: Published numeric rows from one external study, not 100 reviewed papers or 100 newly reconstructed laboratory protocols.
count_definitions.unknown_full_corpus_totals: Unreviewed titles and keyword windows cannot establish whether a material was synthesized, the actual product, complete recipes, variants, controls or duplication. Do not extrapolate reviewed-subset counts.
count_definitions.contextual_observation: Source-scoped characterization series, model interpretations or incomplete observations retained separately from synthesis routes. They do not create additional verified syntheses.
count_definitions.public_material_hub: A locally generated public-facing material/component route. Existence is checked against generated files, not a remote deployment check. Shared canonical record IDs are counted once globally.
count_definitions.nonprocedure_literature: All literature records except supporting procedures: synthesis routes, contextual controls and contextual observations. The observation is excluded from recipe_or_control_literature_records.
count_definitions.legacy_corpus_baseline: The fixed indexed downloaded_papers corpus: 7,373 document files and 4,176 groups with local documents. Incoming-folder tracking is not added to these counts, including byte-duplicate incoming copies.
count_definitions.shared_wafer: The two Heath template variants were prepared on the same wafer in one reported exposure. Individual wells and variant records are not independent synthesis runs.
count_definitions.danek_series: Figure-defined particle sizes, shell ratios, optical aliquots and film-deposition categories are source-scoped observations. Their number must not be interpreted as fully specified independent synthesis recipes.
count_definitions.local_paper_groups_indexed: Actual generated source-library groups, including reviewed incoming-folder sources absent from the earlier legacy index; not a full incoming-corpus count.
count_definitions.local_document_files_indexed: Document-file count from the retained legacy corpus index snapshot; incoming-folder monitor totals are reported separately on the progress page.
count_definitions.reviewed_literature_experimental_row: A source-defined table row with preserved input/output scope. It is not an additional fully specified synthesis route or a deduplicated physical experiment.
count_definitions.historical_augmented_library_groups: Previous public-library snapshot count, retained unchanged; includes legacy intake groups and the canonical additions present at that snapshot.
count_definitions.frozen_intake_local_paper_groups: Distinct DOI groups with local documents in the content-pinned original intake index; curated additions do not change this count.
count_definitions.curated_library_additions: Canonical primary-source DOIs absent from the frozen local-document intake view; not new intake and not additional credit for contextual citations.

corpus_candidate_metadata.candidate_formula_status: Unreviewed string matches, including possible catalysts/supports/analytes/products of testing and parsing errors. Not distinct synthesized-material count.
corpus_candidate_metadata.scope_limit: Indexing/extraction is not recipe curation. Title material mentions do not verify synthesis contributions. No OCR or legacy DOC conversion performed.
